basics.name: Emad Gohari
basics.headline: Senior Machine Learning Engineer · ML Systems, NLP, LLMs

summary: Senior machine learning engineer with **8 years of experience** building ML, NLP, and LLM systems from research to production. At Thomson Reuters Labs, shipped **production GenAI summarization and semantic search**, contributed agent configuration and evaluation tooling to a **commercially launched agentic AI product**, and built **model-retraining pipelines and PII-secure data infrastructure** for CLEAR entity resolution. Combines hands-on model development with reproducible experimentation and evaluation, working with researchers, domain experts, and product teams.

items: Model Training & Evaluation (F1 Score, ROC-AUC, MRR, MAP, Recall@k)

experience.description: Applied ML at TR Labs for CLEAR, Thomson Reuters' due-diligence platform for KYC/AML screening and investigations, and Checkpoint, its tax research platform. Built LLM features and agent workflows, search models, training pipelines, and secure data infrastructure with researchers, subject-matter experts, and product engineering. Used **SQL/PostgreSQL for entity-resolution data analysis and name/address candidate blocking** before downstream ML matching and ranking.

projects.name: Entity Resolution Retraining & Snowflake Pipelines: CLEAR
projects.description: Designed and built an **on-demand model-retraining pipeline** on SageMaker Pipelines, turning researchers' feature-generation, training, and evaluation code into reusable DAG steps. Enabled **parallel experiments tracked in MLflow**, cutting experiment turnaround by an **estimated ~40%**. Built proof-of-concept Snowflake processing and training pipelines and assessed the gaps for migrating AWS research workflows to Snowflake.

projects.name: Agentic Investigation System: CLEAR Investigate
projects.description: Contributed to **CLEAR Investigate, Thomson Reuters' commercially launched agentic AI product** for investigations. Built a **central PydanticAI configuration layer** for system prompts, tool descriptions and availability, and agent/subagent wiring, enabling experimenters to **reconfigure agents from one place** instead of editing scattered definitions. Migrated the team's existing **LLM-as-judge evaluation** capability into an organized repository for reuse and future CI/CD integration.

projects.name: CLEAR Business AI: GenAI Report Summarization
projects.description: Built the LLM summarization workflow for CLEAR Business entity reports, **live in production processing hundreds of reports daily**. Designed selective XML extraction for **targeted per-section context** covering business overview, personnel, adverse media, and legal records. Integrated Bing Search and LLM verification to **reduce same-name entity mismatches** and linked claims to report sources. Refined extraction and prompts through SME annotation rounds against exemplars for **10-15 companies**, and compared **GPT-4 and Claude Sonnet on quality, latency, and cost** to inform model selection.

projects.name: Entity Resolution Data Infrastructure: CLEAR KYC/AML
projects.description: Built research data infrastructure for CLEAR's entity-resolution system spanning **~800M entities and billions of documents**, with a **700 idents/second target**. Designed a **PII-isolated AWS environment** with SageMaker Studio, CloudFormation, and per-researcher profiles; defined a **versioned schema reconciling two incompatible annotation sources**, with Spark and Python pipelines to merge records and surface label conflicts; and replaced manual runs with **scheduled, repeatable SageMaker Pipelines**.

projects.name: Semantic Search Improvement: Checkpoint Tax Research
projects.description: Shipped a **sentence-embedding query-intent classifier** for Checkpoint tax research, distinguishing broad conceptual queries from specific tax lookups to promote higher-level documents. **Improved access to conceptual documents by 95%** within a **~100ms latency budget**. Identified the retrieval gap through SME and customer feedback.

experience.description: Built NLP and language-understanding systems end to end, from data preparation and model training to evaluation and application integration, including transformer fine-tuning and research collaborations with university and industry partners.

projects.name: Automated Question Generation from Documents
projects.description: Fine-tuned the open-weights **T5** model to generate questions from documents, **cutting manual data-curation effort by 40%**. Experimented with input representations and evaluated generated text with BLEURT in a research collaboration with university partners.

projects.name: Domain-Specific Language Understanding
projects.description: Trained domain-specific **Word2Vec embeddings** and **LSTM-based NLU models**, with interpretability testing to make model decisions transparent.

projects.name: Conversational Question Answering with NLP & LSTM Models
projects.description: Developed a **conversational question-answering system** combining syntactic and semantic document analysis with **LSTM-based text tagging**. Used **semi-automatically generated ontologies** to interpret user questions and identify intent, and experimented with knowledge graphs for knowledge representation in an industry research collaboration.
